evidence.citation: Cai, Zhang and Ying (2025), ACS ES&T Water 5, 920-933, https://doi.org/10.1021/acsestwater.4c00933
evidence.source_boundary_translation: For each GDR group, the 2022/2015 industrial-use mass ratio is applied as a dimensionless multiplier to the 2018 riverine source inventory. This assumes that the group-level relationship between industrial use and riverine release is stable over the comparison interval.
evidence.translation_limit: The primary multiplier is a use-based source proxy, not an absolute emission estimate or a calendar-year forecast. Application-weighted water releases are calculated only for applications with an explicitly reported water release fraction and are retained as an incomplete diagnostic.
